name: Non Talkers 'Weight of Doubt Tour'
description: Experience the intimate and soulful melodies of the Portuguese-Belgian indie folk duo Non Talkers as they bring their captivating live show to one of Porto's most iconic venues.
longDescription:
Non Talkers, the indie folk duo comprising a Portuguese and a Belgian musician, will perform their 'Weight of Doubt Tour' at Coliseu Porto Ageas. Known for their intricate arrangements and introspective songwriting, the duo has garnered attention for their unique blend of melancholic melodies and harmonious vocals. Their music often explores themes of introspection and human connection, delivered through a minimalist yet impactful soundscape.

Attendees can expect an evening of reflective and atmospheric music within the grand setting of the Coliseu Porto Ageas. The performance will feature songs from their latest tour, offering an opportunity to engage with their distinctive sound in a live context. The historic venue, known for its ornate architecture and excellent acoustics, provides a fitting backdrop for the duo's intimate musical style. The audience will primarily consist of music enthusiasts drawn to indie folk and singer-songwriter genres.

Tickets for the Non Talkers 'Weight of Doubt Tour' are available for purchase. Coliseu Porto Ageas is centrally located and easily accessible, approximately a 5-minute walk from Bolhão metro station. The venue offers accessible seating options; further details can be confirmed directly with the venue.
